QuestInfo.name: [Snowdrift Lodge] Sweet Suites
QuestInfo.0: To celebrate their opening, the Snowdrift Lodge is having a promotion! Stay in the Snowdrift Lodge Suites 5 times to receive the Snowdrift Lodge VIP title. Besides, staying in the suites grants a special effect!

default.0: We've got a special gift for guests of our suites on their 5th stay! It looks like you don't qualify yet.\r\nGo right from the Lobby to get to the entrance to the suites. But be sure to get a card key from the front desk, first!
